fieldValues.title: Ctrl-Z undoes and Ctrl-Shift-Z redoes the writer's essay edits
fieldValues.move: The essay editor keeps an undo history of the writer's edits for the browser session (text, moves, hide and bin, adds and deletes) and Ctrl-Z / Ctrl-Shift-Z (Cmd on a Mac) step through it, writing each step back to the records as a normal edit. Agent edits are not undone by the writer's Ctrl-Z.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Version history across sessions or between writers; that is SRS revision history, not the editor.
fieldValues.falsifier: The writer presses Ctrl-Z after an edit in the essay and the edit stays, or an undo leaves the records different from before the edit.
fieldValues.return_when: After two weeks of writing with undo, or the first time an undo loses work.
